body.description: Apply or dry-run a unified diff against local UTF-8 text files. Supports Git-style unified diffs, multi-file patches, path overrides, candidate local paths, already-applied detection, no-newline-at-EOF markers, and safe fuzzy hunk matching. The parser is intentionally tolerant of common malformed/LLM diffs. Set dryRun=true to check without writing. Set strict=true to disable fuzzy matching.

candidatePaths.description: Optional local paths to consider if paths parsed from the diff do not resolve. The tool matches by exact path, suffix, and unique basename.

diffText.description: Unified diff text to apply or dry-run. May contain one or more file patches and hunks.

dryRun.description: If true, check applicability and return resolved fileTargets without writing files.

fileTargets.description: Optional explicit target path mappings for file patches. Use when diff paths are missing, wrong, relative to a different base, or ambiguous.

fileKey.description: Parsed file key such as file-1, file-2, etc.

newPath.description: New path from the diff, if known.

oldPath.description: Old path from the diff, if known.

targetPath.description: Actual local file path to use for this file patch.

strict.description: If true, use strict exact hunk matching only. Default false enables safe fuzzy matching.

body.name: applyunifieddiff

definition.description: Apply or dry-run a unified diff against local UTF-8 text files. Supports Git-style unified diffs, multi-file patches, path overrides, candidate local paths, already-applied detection, no-newline-at-EOF markers, and safe fuzzy hunk matching. The parser is intentionally tolerant of common malformed/LLM diffs. Set dryRun=true to check without writing. Set strict=true to disable fuzzy matching.

body.description: Safely delete a file by moving it to a trash directory. trashDir=auto will try to use the system trash when possible; otherwise falls back to a local .trash directory.

path.description: Path of the file to delete.

trashDir.description: Trash destination. Use "auto" to attempt system trash detection; If auto detection fails, a default .trash directory is used. Non-existent directory will be created.

definition.description: Safely delete a file by moving it to a trash directory. trashDir=auto will try to use the system trash when possible; otherwise falls back to a local .trash directory.

body.description: Delete a text block from a UTF-8 text file. Matching compares TrimSpace(line). Use textAbove and/or textBelow only to locate the intended occurrence. Use lineHint only when expectedCount is 1. The tool fails unless the number of matches equals expectedCount.

expectedCount.description: Fail unless exactly this many matches are found. Defaults to 1.

lineHint.description: Optional 1-based hint for the start line of oldText. Use only when expectedCount is 1.

textAbove.description: Optional text above oldText used only to locate the occurrence.

textBelow.description: Optional copied text below oldText used only to locate the occurrence.

body.name: deletetext

definition.description: Delete a text block from a UTF-8 text file. Matching compares TrimSpace(line). Use textAbove and/or textBelow only to locate the intended occurrence. Use lineHint only when expectedCount is 1. The tool fails unless the number of matches equals expectedCount.

body.description: Fetch an HTTP/HTTPS URL. Default auto mode returns compact text for HTML/text/PDF and image/file outputs for binary URLs. Use startIndex to continue truncated text.

encoding.description: Return mode. auto returns text for HTML/text/PDF and image/file outputs for binary URLs. text forces readable text. binary returns base64 image/file output.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of text characters to return. Applies only to text output.

raw.description: For HTML/text responses, return raw decoded text instead of readable Markdown extraction.

startIndex.description: Start text output at this character index. Use the next startIndex from a truncated result to continue.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL to fetch.

body.name: fetchurl

definition.description: Fetch an HTTP/HTTPS URL. Default auto mode returns compact text for HTML/text/PDF and image/file outputs for binary URLs. Use startIndex to continue truncated text.
